title: Hyundai Heavy Industries Campus Addition
role: MLA circular-economies studio — Prof. Sang Cho
summary: A campus-systems study for the Hyundai Heavy Industries site in Ulsan, South Korea (Fall 2025, Prof. Sang Cho): expanding the Mipo-dong wastewater works into a circular-economy landscape where rain gardens and detention ponds feed purified water to hydrogen production powered by offshore wind, with public hiking trails threading the working site.

sections.heading: Brief
sections.body: Campus-scale systems design in an international industrial context: rainwater filters through bamboo rain gardens into detention ponds; purified water feeds PEM electrolysis producing hydrogen fuel, powered by offshore wind. By-product loops carry timber, rice-bran bioplastics, biogas from anaerobic digesters, and smart farming — and public hiking trails weave through the working site.
